data_fields.name: stickDeadZone
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.1 (fraction of pad, per axis, from centre)

data_fields.name: stickCornerZone
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.3 (fraction from each edge that means a diagonal)

data_fields.name: stickSamplePeriodMs
data_fields.donor_constant: 20 (donor timer; Frankendom samples per fixed step instead)

best_idea: A thumb pad that turns a fingertip offset into one of eight directions with a dead zone and corner diagonals, with the knob clamped to a small circle, sampled on a fixed step.
decision_why: Frankendom's phone world move needs this input shape; the donor's 20 ms timer and normalised-axis maths are changed (defects 1-3 fixed in the sketch).
acceptance: On a 375 px phone, holding the thumb in the pad's top-right corner moves the hero north-east in the zone; the knob stays inside a 75 px circle; a press inside the dead zone sends no intent; releasing stops intent on the next fixed step (unit test: readStick at (0.85 x 175, 0.15 x 150) returns NE).
